Problem: Search an Element in a Singly Linked List

You are given N integers.
Create a Singly Linked List by inserting elements at the end.

Then you are given an integer X.
Your task is to check whether X exists in the linked list.

Input Format
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
X

N → number of elements

Next line contains N space-separated integers

Last line contains integer X (element to search)

Output Format

Print "Found" if element exists

Print "Not Found" if element does not exist
input_spec:
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
X

N → number of elements

Next line contains N space-separated integers

Last line contains integer X (element to search)
output_spec:
Print "Found" if element exists

Print "Not Found" if element does not exist
constraints:
1 ≤ N ≤ 1000

-10^9 ≤ ai, X ≤ 10^9
